reset.confirmContent: Reset will clear this lesson's learning data. Are you sure?
reset.title: Reset

retake.busy: This lesson is still generating or recovering. Try again later.
retake.exhausted: No retakes remain for this lesson. You can continue studying, review existing content or ask questions.
retake.invalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 2147483647, or leave blank.
retake.last: 1 retake remains for this lesson. This is the last one; to revise, consider reviewing existing content.
retake.loadFailed: Could not check your allowance. Close and try again.
retake.remaining: {count} retakes remain for this lesson. First study, continuation and review do not use retakes.
retake.settingHelp: Each learner has a separate allowance for each lesson; first study is excluded. Leave blank for unlimited, or use 0 for no extra retakes. Saving applies immediately to all learners and preserves usage.
retake.useChapter: Retakes are managed for this course. To regenerate or change a submitted answer, use this lesson’s Reset action. Existing content remains available.
